method: Namespace-adapted three-way merge against the original imported seed, preserving existing local changes
local_contracts: Explicit hybrid-ane backend and native ANE lifecycle
All eight routed experts in ANE mode
Prefill chunk sizes 32/64/128/256/512/1024, by default the smallest that covers the prompt
Reference-order SIMD attention, including upstream image visibility
Routed experts served zero-copy from the OS page cache (no app-level slot cache)
Device supervisor with ANE routed-prefill guest, local profiling and numerical oracles
scope: Imported runtime, compact format, CLI, model installer, and their regression tests. The upstream GUI and server are not imported; this repository's server is its own.
benchmark_boundary: September 16 post-merge comparison uses unmodified latest Turbo 4c6db1e with matched release toolchain, official generation fixtures/settings, nine discarded warmups and eighteen measured runs. The receipts are kept locally and not published. September 8 receipts are historical comparisons against 6c044011.

additional_imports.author: maxslamdunk
local_changes: early reads are F_RDADVISE advisories into the page cache: no staging buffers, never blocking
candidates limited to the guess's top 8 and absent from memory
the same guess advises each verify row's next-layer experts
builds under this repository's strict settings: Swift 6 strict memory safety, ExistentialAny, internal imports by default, warnings as errors
no @unchecked Sendable: the download session builds a configuration per session, and the redirect and range-transfer delegates and the progress reporter keep their mutable state in a Mutex
no force unwraps: buffer-taking pread/pwrite overloads, a checked Hugging Face base URL constant, dictionary entries iterated instead of re-looked-up
the resident index is staged in a raw allocation rather than an unwrapped buffer
tool names, receipts and temporary files say ANEFieldfareInstall; install-plan hash domains are unchanged
the test URL stub's scripted state is behind a Mutex
